title: Visual QA respects hidden roles, verified fragment status and occluded border geometry
steps: Measure ancestor-hidden navigation and display-none CTA on both sides, then expose the source CTA only.
Navigate twice to the same fragment, to another fragment, and to a real 404 document.
Scan a scrolled sticky header overlapping an input border, then adjacent visible, offscreen and nested hero borders.
expect: Hidden roles are absent on both sides; a genuinely visible source-only role still produces a parity finding.
Same-document navigation preserves independently verified HTTP status; a real 404 never passes as 200.
A border proven covered by an opaque surface or border is ignored; real visible, offscreen and nested seams still produce findings.
evidence: Independent responsive r10 observed 34 false nav/CTA findings plus null-response fragment navigation failure. Baseline and fixed fixture output are retained in acceptance evidence. Contact r12 false seam aligned sticky header bottom with an occluded input border at document y629.
fence: Tests exercise the actual shared browser helpers against real HTTP fixtures; no model or customer site state.

cmd: --test-name-pattern=hidden responsive nav|same-document fragment navigation|seam scanning ignores
